monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement routes high-intent guide-hub visitors to first-purchase, label, product-problem, public-event, workplace-testing, and responsible-use decisions; the event guide adds a total-price and checkout record without merchants, products, tickets, prices, coupons, rankings, reviews, or paid placement.

image_qa.note: The new guide, hub router, and trust update use semantic text, tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No editorial, event, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 21–October 18 report showed 1,093 impressions, three clicks, 0.274% CTR, and average position 19.199. The Guides hub was the clearest non-branded navigation surface with engagement (three impressions, one click, position 7.3), so today's one Data-led change adds six task-first paths and improves its route into useful content. The Stem Cell CBG page at 19 impressions, one click, and position 6.0 was deliberately not reinforced again because it already received material support on October 15 and October 24. About and Contact impressions were treated as navigational, Montana and one-impression legal rows as too small, and Blue Dream queries at roughly positions 48–70 as outside the supported opportunity range.

authority.action: Published a primary-source-based New York Cannabis Showcase Event verification asset using adopted Part 117, the current OCM legal-activity locator, OCM consumer resources, and CDC driving and poisoning guidance. Its permittee/participant matrix, display-versus-sale boundary, price record, and event-to-home handoff card are connected reciprocally to seller verification and social-hosting resources. No outreach was sent and no speculative outreach target was logged.
